decisions.question: Which incident/action export should the triage read? None was supplied in the working directory on 2026-09-21; the analysis cannot name blocked actions until an authorized export (incident, action, status, assignee, activation and due dates, predecessor links) with its observation time and timezone is provided.
Which project manifest, workflow design and groups apply to these incidents? Without them, owners can only be named by the assignee text in the export, not by group key.
Confirm the country, response language and timezone for the triage. Angola / en / Africa/Luanda were assumed provisionally because no context was supplied.
